NaCDEC VI – Design Challenge
Saturday, August 12, 2023
9:00 AM  7:00 PM

‘NACDeC VI - The National Design Challenge: Air Ambulance’ was a year-long competition organized by ARTPARK @ IISc, AeSI Design Division and AeSI Mumbai Branch and The Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE), India. Over 45 brilliant ideas and designs took flight in the competition, all aiming to create an autonomous and advanced Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) vehicle for advanced air mobility.
